messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Restyle the person's hair to match the hairstyle shown in the reference images, using the references only for the hairstyle shape. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please restyle the person's hair according to the reference images. Use the reference images only for the hairstyle. Keep the person's identity, hair color, clothing, and all other aspects of the current video unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The person stands in profile, then raises both arms overhead to perform a stretching or dance-like motion before lowering them back down.","camera":"The camera maintains a static, medium shot from the side, capturing the person from the thighs up.","clothing":"The person wears a light-colored, plaid button-down shirt with rolled-up sleeves, dark plaid pants, and brown leather suspenders.","hair_color":"The hair is a vibrant, bright blue.","hairstyle":"The person has a high ponytail with the sides of the head shaved.","identity":"A person with a medium-brown complexion and a short, dark beard is shown in profile.","scene":"The setting is an outdoor paved area, possibly a road or parking lot, with a metal guardrail, rocks, and green trees in the background under a bright sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The person's hair changed from a short blue crop to a high blue ponytail with shaved sides, matching the reference shape. The blue color, clothing, scene, camera, and body motion remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Restyle the person's hair to match the reference hairstyle shape, while preserving identity, bright blue hair color, clothing, and all other video aspects.
uncertain: Exact match to the reference hairstyle shape is difficult to verify from the side view, though the high ponytail and shaved sides are clearly present.
unexpected_changes: The ponytail appears somewhat glossy and rigid in some frames, but this is likely due to the new hairstyle rendering rather than a separate unintended change.
